name: Thompson Savannah
positioning: Midcentury modern riverfront hotel (officially Thompson Savannah, by Hyatt) where Savannah's Historic District meets the Eastern Wharf, with a rooftop bar, a coastal Southern restaurant and a pool deck
best_for: Travelers who want a Savannah River base near the Historic District
Food lovers interested in hyperlocal coastal Southern cooking

facts.text: Thompson Savannah sits along the Savannah River's edge where the Historic District meets the Eastern Wharf.
The hotel's address is 201 Port Street, Savannah, Georgia.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and rainfall showers.
City-inspired botanical patterns, curated artwork and herringbone wood floors decorate the rooms.
Rooms come with custom 400-thread count Sferra linens and D.S. & Durga bath products.
Bar Julian, the hotel's rooftop bar, has sweeping views of the Savannah River and a Mediterranean-inspired menu.
Bar Julian serves breakfast, bar snacks and locally-inspired pizzas.
Stevedore Bakery, on the ground floor, works with local partners such as PERC Coffee.
Courtesy hotel bikes are available for exploring Savannah.
Woodhouse Spa is steps from the hotel, offering treatments and infrared sauna experiences.
Taste of Thompson dinner parties offer a four-course meal or a cocktail party with paired bites, built on hyper-local ingredients.
The hotel is 11 miles from Savannah/Hilton Head International Airport.

highlights.text: Bar Julian is the tallest rooftop bar in Savannah's modern history.
Fleeting, the signature restaurant, serves elevated coastal Southern cuisine on an ever-evolving menu that celebrates hyperlocal ingredients.
Fleeting's shareable dishes include wood-grilled oysters with chartreuse-lemongrass butter.
The pool deck has a splash pool with in-water loungers, plus private cabanas with daybeds overlooking the pool.
Dogs of all breeds and sizes are welcome at no additional charge.

considerations.text: The pool is a splash pool with in-water loungers.
Cats cannot be accommodated, and Bar Julian is 21 and over after 10pm.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's upscale positioning.
